description: This file defines the UnsafeMapType struct and its methods for low-level map operations using unsafe pointers, including creation, access, modification, iteration, and type assertions within the reflect2 package.

classes.name: UnsafeMapType
classes.description: A struct representing a low-level, unsafe map type with methods for map operations.

classes.name: UnsafeMapIterator
classes.description: A struct for iterating over map entries at a low level using unsafe pointers.

methods.name: newUnsafeMapType
methods.description: Creates a new UnsafeMapType instance based on a reflect.Type.

methods.name: IsNil
methods.description: Checks if the given map object is nil.

methods.name: UnsafeIsNil
methods.description: Checks if the unsafe pointer to a map is nil.

methods.name: LikePtr
methods.description: Indicates that the type behaves like a pointer.

methods.name: Indirect
methods.description: Returns the indirect value of a map object.

methods.name: UnsafeIndirect
methods.description: Returns the indirect value of a map from an unsafe pointer.

methods.name: Key
methods.description: Returns the key type of the map.

methods.name: MakeMap
methods.description: Creates a new map with the specified capacity.

methods.name: UnsafeMakeMap
methods.description: Creates a new map as an unsafe pointer with the specified capacity.

methods.name: SetIndex
methods.description: Sets a key-value pair in the map.

methods.name: UnsafeSetIndex
methods.description: Sets a key-value pair in the map using unsafe pointers.

methods.name: TryGetIndex
methods.description: Attempts to get a value by key from the map, returning the value and a boolean indicating success.

methods.name: GetIndex
methods.description: Gets a value by key from the map.

methods.name: UnsafeGetIndex
methods.description: Gets a value by key from the map using unsafe pointers.

methods.name: Iterate
methods.description: Returns an iterator for the map.
